title: The ambulance services in-house or outsourced are commensurate with the scope of the services provided by the organization

The ambulance services in-house or outsourced are commensurate with the scope of the services provided by the organization

Sr. No.Particulars
AIntroduction

CResponsibility

1.0 INTRODUCTION:

1.1 To define the ambulance services

2.0 SCOPE:

2.1 Hospital Management

2.2 Health Care Providers

2.3 Patients

2.4 Government agencies

3.0 RESPONSIBILITY:

3.1 Doctors

3.2 Nursing staff

3.3 Ambulance Driver

4.0 ABBREVIATIONS:

4.1 COP-Care of Patient

5.0 DEFINITION: Nil

6.0 REFERENCE:

6.1 NABH:Accreditation Standards For Ayurveda Hospitals 2nd Edition April 2016.

7.0 OBJECTIVE ELEMENTS

7.1. There is adequate access and space for the ambulance(s).

7.2 The ambulance adheres to statutory requirements.

7.3 Ambulance(s) is appropriately equipped.

7.4 Ambulance(s) is manned by trained personnel.

7.5 Ambulance is checked on a daily basis.

7.6 Equipment is checked on a daily basis.

7.7 Emergency medications are checked daily and prior to dispatch.

7.8 The ambulance(s) has a proper communication system.

8. 0 PROCESSES

8.1The organization demarcated a proper space for an ambulance near the hospital entrance

8.2 Ambulance comply statutory requirements like insurance policy and registration

8.3 Basic Ambulance services is available in Hospital and Advance life support is available in Shalinitai Meghe Hospital And research Centre for both adult and pediatric patients

8.4 The ambulance manned by a licensed and trained driver, technician/Paricharaka and/or doctor, depending on the situation, trained in BLS.

8.5 Ambulance is checked on a daily basis for functioning status by the Matron and documented.

8.6 Ambulance is checked on a daily basis for functioning of equipment status by Matron and documented.

8.7 Emergency medicines are checked on a daily basis by Matron and documented.

8.8 Ambulance is connected with the organization with mobile phones of the driver and attending Doctor (If Attended).
